output.hook: Missed a day? That’s why you quit last time.

scenes.visual: App icon: Streakly with tagline 'Habits that survive real life.'
scenes.voiceover: Missed a day? That’s why you quit last time.

scenes.visual: User marks a habit as missed, then sees 'Repair Streak' option and taps it
scenes.voiceover: Streakly doesn’t end your streak when life happens. Repair it by doubling up within the week.

scenes.visual: Weekly view showing habit progress against a target, not a daily chain
scenes.voiceover: We score habits against weekly targets, not unbroken chains. Based on behavior-change research, not guilt.

scenes.visual: Settings screen: 'Data stored on device', 'No account needed', 'No social feed'
scenes.voiceover: Private by default. Your data stays on your device. No accounts, no sharing, no pressure.

scenes.visual: App Store review screen showing 4.8 stars from 96 reviews
scenes.voiceover: 41% of beta users were still tracking at day 30. That’s 2.5x better than typical habit app retention.

scenes.visual: App icon with CTA button: 'Join the Beta'
scenes.voiceover: Streakly: habits that survive real life. Join the free beta today.
